summary: Silvercorp Metals Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing a revised notice of record and meeting dates for its upcoming Annual General and Special Meeting scheduled for September 25, 2026. The record and voting date is August 12, 2026, for common shareholders, with notice-and-access procedures for Canadian holders and full packages for non-Canadian registered holders. This is a routine administrative notice regarding corporate governance logistics, not a special-situations event. The business to be conducted is described only as annual general and special, with no disclosed transformative proposals. No deal terms, premiums, or strategic actions are referenced.
